verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI inference and training platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only one-off asynchronous batch inference and REST API automation, which are building blocks rather than a recurring scheduler. The 'scheduling' mention in the fine-tuning docs refers to GPU resource scheduling, not user-defined recurring schedules, so no documented capability delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
